example_phrases: who is responsible for the bins in my student house
will I get fined if bins stay out
what do I do with my old furniture when I move out

facts.caveat: Re-check the fine amount before the demo.
facts.fact: Tenants, not landlords, are responsible for making sure household waste is disposed of properly. Everyone in the house shares responsibility for the right waste in the bins, putting them out and bringing them back in. Bins repeatedly left on the street can lead to a 60 pound fine.
